content:
jess: heads up — we got a bug report from a user running the JS SDK in Bun + Deno edge that fails to import because of our package exports field. stack: Bun (v1.2) and Deno (v1.35)

sam: ugh the conditional exports dance. can you paste the package.json exports?

jess: here —
```json
{
  \"exports\": {
    \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\",
    \"./*\": {
      \"require\": \"./cjs/*.cjs\",
      \"import\": \"./esm/*.js\"
    }
  }
}
```

rahul: that looks fine for node, but Bun and Deno handle the spec differently. Bun sometimes prefers extension-based resolution and Deno ignores package exports entirely for remote imports.

maria: also saw failures where fetch + retries break because the request body is a stream and can't be replayed after a retry in edge runtimes. user reported 415-ish or a closed body.

jess: ah yes — the edge runtime in Deno deploy clones/wraps body differently. our retry layer assumes body.clone() or that body can be re-created. not true on some runtimes.

kevin: short-term patch: detect non-replayable bodies and only retry idempotent methods, or buffer small payloads (< 4kb) into memory before sending.

sam: agree. can we also adjust package.json: add conditional mapping for \"deno\" and \"bun\" keys? e.g.,
```json
\"exports\": {
  \"./node\": { \"import\": \"./esm/index.js\" },
  \"./deno\": { \"import\": \"./deno/mod.ts\" },
  \"./bun\": { \"import\": \"./bun/index.js\" }
}
```

rahul: Deno won't read package.json from remote imports unless you use compat shims — better to publish a deno/mod.ts that re-exports the ESM build and document the URL. For Bun, adding an explicit file with .js/.cjs helps.

maria: typing issue: our sdk/index.d.ts uses Node types for AbortSignal and CryptoKey which breaks in Deno (global types differ). Users see TS2304 errors.

kevin: we should provide a triple entry: main/module/types — types pointing to types-deno.d.ts that uses WebCrypto and DOM libs, and types-node.d.ts using node types. consumers pick based on tsconfig. messy but explicit.

jess: proposed action items:
- add a lightweight deno/mod.ts that re-exports our ESM API and documents auth usage (token via header)
- change retry logic: fallback to no-retry if body is a stream and not cloneable; buffer small bodies with limit; log a DX warning
- add a bun-friendly entry file with explicit extensions
- add types-deno.d.ts and update package.json \"types\" conditional entry if possible, otherwise publish in release notes

sam: agree. can we also add an example repo: sdk-examples/deno-bun-minimal showing import URLs, auth example for both, and a small test that runs in CI?

ci-bot: note — create ticket RFC-142 on repo/internals for conditional types and a small CI matrix for deno/bun tests.

rahul: one more gotcha: globalThis.crypto vs crypto.subtle — Deno uses globalThis.crypto.subtle, Node uses require('crypto').webcrypto. our code should call (globalThis.crypto || require('crypto').webcrypto) where available, guarded by typeof require !== 'undefined'.

maria: can we add runtime detection helper in utils/runtime.ts and export it for sample apps?

jess: yep — I'll draft a small PR with the runtime helper + deno/mod.ts + changelog notes. assigning to @sam for the retry logic and @kevin for types follow-up.

sam: will start a branch: fix/edge-retry-and-entries

kevin: I'll prototype types-deno.d.ts and drop a Readme section on tsconfig libs to include (DOM, WebWorker, WebCrypto).

jess: thanks team. rough timeline: ship quick patches (deno/mod + bun entry + buffering retry) this week, types and CI matrix next sprint. will post PR links. :rocket:
